title: learning reverse process variances causes instability
description: Incorporating learnable variances for the reverse process leads to unstable training and worse sample quality compared to fixing the variances as constants.
canonical_description: learning reverse process variances leads to unstable training and poor sample quality

evidence.quote: learning reverse process variances (by incorporating a parameterized diagonal Σ_θ(x_t) into the variational bound) leads to unstable training and poorer sample quality compared to fixed variances
